evaluation_contract.purpose: Development regression checking only. Do not report its pass count as RQ2 accuracy or evidence of generalisation.

evaluation_contract.state_rule: Start every case with an empty state; preserve context within a case until reset.
evaluation_contract.semantic_scoring: Automated checks inspect structure and provenance. Full semantic assessment remains a separate human task.
